verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents a self-serve seller path: create a seller agent and API key in the dashboard, click Create Service with pricing and identity requirements, submit it, and then collect payment through the Charge Token API. It also has docs for publishing an MCP server resource that tells agents which tokens to send. The main caveat is that seller services are approval-gated by Skyfire, so onboarding is not instant. Missing for 10: documented approval criteria or timeline, independent or hands-on corroboration of seller onboarding, and a detailed merchant guide for letting agents through a bot manager on a website.
